record.original_question: Does there exist a sequence of separable non-Gamma II_1 factors (N_i) such that their ultraproduct ∏_{i→U} N_i has property Gamma?

evidence.quote: Problem 15. Does there exist a sequence of separable non Gamma factors Ni such that their ultraproduct ∏ i→U Ni has Property Gamma?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor with separable predual and faithful normal trace $\tau$. Recall that $M$ is said to have property Gamma if for every finite subset $F \subset M$ and every $\varepsilon > 0$ there exists a unitary $u \in M$ with $\tau(u) = 0$ such that $\|[u,x]\|_2 < \varepsilon$ for all $x \in F$; equivalently, $M' \cap M^{\mathcal{U}} \neq \mathbb{C}\,1$ for some (equivalently every) free ultrafilter $\mathcal{U}$ on $\mathbb{N}$, where $M^{\mathcal{U}}$ denotes the tracial ultrapower. Given a sequence $(N_i)_{i\in\mathbb{N}}$ of $\mathrm{II}_1$ factors with separable preduals and a free ultrafilter $\mathcal{U}$ on $\mathbb{N}$, the tracial ultraproduct $\prod_{i\to\mathcal{U}} N_i$ is defined as $\ell^\infty(\mathbb{N},(N_i))/\mathcal{I}_{\mathcal{U}}$, where $\mathcal{I}_{\mathcal{U}}$ is the ideal of bounded sequences $(x_i)$ with $\lim_{i\to\mathcal{U}}\|x_i\|_2 = 0$; it is again a $\mathrm{II}_1$ factor with trace $\tau((x_i)) = \lim_{i\to\mathcal{U}} \tau_{N_i}(x_i)$.

Question: Does there exist a sequence $(N_i)_{i\in\mathbb{N}}$ of separable $\mathrm{II}_1$ factors, none of which has property Gamma, and a free ultrafilter $\mathcal{U}$ on $\mathbb{N}$, such that the tracial ultraproduct $\prod_{i\to\mathcal{U}} N_i$ has property Gamma?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed among open problems on ultraproduct II_1 factors. Web searches indicate active research on non-Gamma II_1 factors and their ultraproducts (e.g., work on non-elementary equivalence of non-Gamma factors), but no resolution to whether a sequence of non-Gamma separable II_1 factors can have an ultraproduct with property Gamma was found.

status_evidence.title: An exotic II_1 factor without property Gamma
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of separable II_1 factors without property Gamma using free probability and deformation/rigidity techniques.
status_evidence.claim: The study of non-Gamma II_1 factors and their ultraproduct/ultrapower behavior is an active research topic with recent constructions but no resolution of the stated emergence problem.

status_evidence.title: Ultraproducts of von Neumann Algebras
status_evidence.snippet: General framework for tracial ultraproducts of II_1 factors and their central sequence algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Standard reference establishing context of property Gamma via relative commutants in ultrapowers.
